algorithm: 1. Call existing guarded inspect exactly once. Hold proof, journal, both raw files and directories. Corrupt/Cancelled gives no sink access. Sealed or Interrupted may be inspected, with original seal/torn/incomplete/uncommitted facts retained. Never read physical bytes beyond journal-committed lengths.

2. Scan each complete committed prefix with the existing native index and verified ClockDescriptor. Accumulate O(1) summaries plus the existing versioned observation digest: first/last eligible unit, count, first/end clocks, semantic configuration and complete byte end. Every emitted unit is provisional until the terminal outcome is checked. Reject any Failed outcome, no units, configuration change, gap, overlap/reset, ordinal/byte discontinuity or arithmetic overflow even if an earlier prefix looked usable.

3. Complete is eligible; PartialTail is eligible only when its offset is at or after the last emitted complete unit end and within the committed extent. Record the exact unparsed tail. A last CommittedEof unit on the track with a verified incomplete logical append is conservatively withheld unless it ended before that incomplete append began; explicit NextInitialization/FiniteEnd complete units remain eligible. Preserve that withheld unit and bytes as a fixed incomplete_append exclusion. This avoids treating the end of a torn native transfer as an asserted source unit boundary.

4. The eligible AAC units must form one continuous rational clock interval. Rescan video once, checking the full observation digest and terminal outcome, and choose the first through last consecutive whole video units whose [first,end) are contained in that AAC interval. Use checked i128 cross-products, never float epsilon, wall time or generation numbers. If no whole video unit is covered, return NoCoveredInterval. Initial and trailing complete video units not covered are explicitly excluded; an interior hole is failure.

5. Rescan audio once and select the consecutive AAC units whose [first,end) intersect the retained video interval. Verify selected audio starts at/before video start and ends at/after video end under checked rational comparisons. Selected AAC unit extents are not an output packet plan. Save only first/last ordinal, byte range, source clocks and bounded counts, not a Vec of every unit/packet.

6. Check all held identities, physical lengths, proof/journal lengths and cancellation again before returning the capability. Preparation needs at most four structural scans (one per track for summaries, then one per track for selection), independent of unit count. Never perform select_unit N times or collect all raw bytes.

7. Each visit rescans its original committed prefix, revalidates every unit, same original outcome and observation digest, and invokes work only for the already chosen consecutive ordinal range. The selected range must reproduce exactly. Final guard failure overrides successful callbacks. No omitted malformed or changed tail can be hidden by scanning only a shorter caller-selected prefix.

bounds.memory: O(1) unit summaries and at most two exclusion summaries per track plus fixed scalars. Existing128KiB scratch and64KiB metadata caps; no all-unit or packet allocation.
bounds.cancellation: Check before held inspection, within existing index/read loops, before each callback, after callback/cursor restore and immediately before successful return. Cancelled never produces a usable selection.
bounds.exclusions: Each track has at most a leading and trailing byte/ordinal range. Interrupted/torn/uncommitted provenance remains independent and sticky; no raw text, URL or media bytes in diagnostics.

pureAndGuardedTests: Both Complete sources select the same all-unit range and keep pending flags true.
Complete unit followed by partial EBML header/Cluster/block or partial ftyp/moov/moof/mdat preserves only the proved complete prefix and exact excluded bytes.

Audio begins late so the first complete video unit is excluded, audio ends early so the final complete video unit is excluded, and both conditions together. Exact equality and one-tick differences use checked rational arithmetic.

Corrupt receipt/hash/identity, cancelled token, replaced proof/directory, changed physical length, torn journal and uncommitted raw tail retain existing guarded semantics. No uncommitted byte is read.
Callback failure/unwind poisons the selection, cursor restores even on failure, callbacks cannot retain borrowed handles, repeated visit reproduces exact selection, stale/cancelled visit fails.
